observations: Photo 0: A black ThinkPad laptop open on a desk, screen showing a green forest wallpaper. The ThinkPad logo is visible on the palm rest. A sticker with Intel Core i5 and Windows 11 logos is on the lower left of the keyboard. The laptop is resting on a closed ThinkPad laptop or sleeve with 'ThinkPad' written on it.

Photo 1: Same laptop, screen showing a blue lock screen with time '5:44'. The keyboard and trackpad are visible. The same Intel and Windows stickers are present. The ThinkPad logo is visible on the palm rest.
Photo 2: Same laptop, screen showing the Lenovo logo during boot-up. The keyboard and trackpad are visible. The same stickers and ThinkPad branding are present.
All photos show the same device from slightly different angles, with consistent branding and stickers.
No visible damage to the screen or keyboard in any photo.
The laptop appears to be a 13-inch model based on size relative to the desk and plant.

The Intel Core i5 sticker is visible in all photos, but it does not specify the generation. The sticker alone does not confirm 11th Gen.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 13-inch ThinkPad, which is lower than X13 Yoga Gen 2.

risks.risk: The screen may not be a touchscreen or may not have WUXGA IPS resolution.
risks.proof: A video showing the screen being touched to confirm touchscreen functionality, or a screenshot of display settings showing resolution and panel type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-touchscreen or lower-resolution display, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The processor may not be 11th Gen Intel Core.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information or CPU-Z showing the exact processor model.
